notes.title: v1.10 Update - A Quality of Life improvement
notes.content:
A new update is here! 

[b]v1.1.0[/b] consists of bug fixes, QOL improvements, new features, and other changes to hopefully improve your experience. 

Thank you for all your feedback and support so far! 

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed automation settings not saving or resetting properly
[*] Fixed training automation freezing in magic school
[*] Fixed story notification display and popup order
[*] Fixed incorrect requirement checking after regression
[*] Fixed essence display and happiness UI
[*] Fixed alignment and margin issues in exploration and technology cards
[/list]

[b]Additions & Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added age and essence conditions for reset automation
[*] Added technology hints
[*] Added new redeem codes
[*] Added glossary and tooltips for exploration and automation icons
[*] Added native file dialog support for loading saves manually
[*] Added legacy save compatibility for mobile save
[*] Added power accumulation visual updates
[*] Added essence gain display to death screen
[*] Added hint for goblin kills in description
[*] Added new temporal skill: Perennial Investments
[*] Added mobile mode when window is resized to portrait mode
[/list]

[b]Balance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed Temporal Haste danger reduction
[*] Nerfed Temporal Essence bonus (10% → 5%)
[*] Buffed Herbal Lore to grant food level
[/list]

[b] Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased font size for dropdowns
[*] Updated loading screen messages 
[*] Updated lifestyle story entries
[*] Optimization
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.16 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks to all of you who shared feedback and bug reports through the Community Hub and Discord, your input has been invaluable in improving the game! The update has bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and balance changes. Here's what's new:

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix Automation Tab button update and margin
[*] Fix Gold and Renown not resetting when temporal skills are reset
[*] Fix buttons not responding to clicks
[*] Fix Story not popping up on unlock
[*] Fix Danger Reduction not updating on game start
[*] Fix Death popup not showing on start
[*] Fix save file lost issue
[/list]

[b]QOL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Card notifications to only show when unlocked for the first time
[*] Added Window Mode settings
[*] Added minimum window size.
[*] Added new hotkeys:
    - [b]Space[/b]: Pause/Unpause  
    - [b]Esc[/b]: Toggle sidebar  
    - [b]S[/b]: Toggle speed  
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Poison Sac[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Ring of Darkness[/spoiler] has been nerfed
[*] [spoiler]Spiritual Illusions[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Skeleton Guards[/spoiler] explorations has been buffed
[/list]
